title: Shifting a Line Vertically
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: The graph of the line y = 2x - 7 is to be shifted up 7 units. Give an equation for the shifted graph and describe the original and shifted lines.

steps.title: Apply the Upward Vertical Shift Rule
steps.explanation: To shift the graph of y = f(x) upward by 7 units, add 7 to the right-hand side of the equation.
steps.why: Vertical translation upward by k units transforms y = f(x) into y = f(x) + k.

steps.title: Simplify the Shifted Linear Equation
steps.explanation: The constant terms -7 and +7 cancel identically, leaving the proportional linear equation y = 2x.

steps.title: Compare the Original and Shifted Lines
steps.explanation: Both lines are parallel with slope 2. The original line y = 2x - 7 has y-intercept (0, -7) and x-intercept (7/2, 0), whereas the shifted line y = 2x passes directly through the origin (0, 0).
steps.why: Translating a line produces a parallel line with identical slope and shifted intercepts.
